scope: Preserve semantically invalid but parseable DXF LAYER values on tolerant read, emit bounded diagnostics, and require explicit repair before structured output.

implementation.rawLineweight: Group 370 values outside -3..211 retain their exact raw integer alongside the existing mapped enum; the marker is copied with DRW_Layer and cleared only by a later valid group 370 or explicit legal repair.
implementation.compatibilityRead: Incomplete table records, invalid payloads and duplicate handles still fail. Representable semantic violations are published with one bounded non-fatal dxf-layer-value-preserved secondary diagnostic.
implementation.structuredOutput: DXF LAYER output rejects invalid semantics; DWG LAYER encoding additionally refuses to serialize an unrepaired out-of-range raw group 370 as the compatibility-mapped default.
implementation.repairApi: repairDxfLineweight accepts width00..width23 or widthDefault, rejects ByLayer/ByBlock for LAYER records, and clears the raw-invalid marker only after a legal value is selected.

semanticCases: out-of-range lineweight -4 with exact raw-value retention
out-of-range lineweight 500 with exact raw-value retention
invalid group 370 followed by valid -3 uses the last value and clears the warning marker
assertions: semantic table rows and following two LINE entities are retained
each malformed semantic row has one non-fatal dxf-layer-value-preserved diagnostic
invalid row export refuses without replacing an existing valid destination
legal explicit repair permits structured DXF output
unrepaired raw-invalid lineweight refuses DWG encoding without output bytes

validation.consumerSourceCompatibility: PASS: cmake --build build-gcc --target lc3_compat_check -j 2 (source compile gate only; no binary-ABI claim)
validation.diffCheck: PASS: git diff --check on touched source, tests and plan

claimBoundary: Local generated ASCII/binary controls establish this library's tolerant-read and strict-writer policy only; they do not establish independent producer compatibility, native CAD display acceptance, or broad LAYER/DWG/DXF support.
worktree: Pre-existing worktree was broadly dirty; this slice remains uncommitted to avoid committing unrelated shared changes.
